lines.trans: Diversification, diversification... I am tired of repeating this!
Vanya, you must clearly learn the terms.
Why do I need to know these difficult words?
You are a candidate and will soon meet with Putin!
My head already aches badly.
Pull yourself together, the city economy depends on you.
What does this diversification actually mean at all?
This is the development of different directions in business.
You should have said so in simple words right away!
Repeat one more time loudly and confidently.
Diversification of the municipal economy of Sineozersk!
Now that sounds like a real mayor!
